title: A4 Image Captioner
description: Streamlit + BLIP app, Prometheus and node_exporter.

panels.title: App
panels.description: up{job="caption_app"}. 1 = Prometheus could scrape :18000.

panels.title: Node exporter
panels.description: up{job="node"}

panels.title: Prometheus
panels.description: up{job="prometheus"}

panels.title: Model loaded
panels.description: caption_model_loaded. Shows 0 when the app is down.

panels.title: App uptime
panels.description: time() - process_start_time_seconds of the app.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Number of alerts from rules.yml that are firing.

panels.title: Up/down history
panels.description: up for each job over time. Red = scrape failed.

panels.title: Throughput (images/s)
panels.description: rate() of caption_images_processed_total over 1m, ok only, by mode.

panels.title: Inference latency p50 / p95
panels.description: histogram_quantile on caption_inference_seconds. y axis is log2.

panels.title: Mean request time
panels.description: caption_request_seconds _sum / _count. A bulk request is the whole ZIP.

panels.title: Requests in progress
panels.description: caption_active_requests and caption_model_queue_length (waiting for the model).

panels.title: Latency heatmap
panels.description: caption_inference_seconds buckets, per minute.

panels.title: Bulk progress
panels.description: caption_bulk_images_remaining. Goes up when a ZIP starts, down per image.

panels.title: Last finished ZIP
panels.description: caption_last_batch_* gauges.

panels.title: Average upload size
panels.description: _sum / _count of caption_zip_bytes, caption_image_bytes and caption_zip_images.

panels.title: Image resolution (megapixels)
panels.description: caption_image_megapixels buckets since the app started.

panels.title: Caption length (words)
panels.description: caption_caption_words buckets since the app started.

panels.title: Images per client
panels.description: caption_images_processed_total by client_ip, session_id and browser.

targets.expr: sum by (client_ip, session_id, browser, mode, status) (caption_images_processed_total) > 0

panels.title: Requests per session
panels.description: caption_requests_total by session and mode.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: caption_active_sessions

panels.title: Sessions opened
panels.description: caption_sessions_started_total

panels.title: Failed images by error type
panels.description: increase(caption_errors_total[1m]) by error_type.

panels.title: Skipped ZIP entries
panels.description: caption_zip_entries_skipped_total by reason.

panels.title: Error ratio (15m)
panels.description: Failed images / all images in the last 15 min.

panels.title: Unhandled exceptions
panels.description: caption_unhandled_exceptions_total. Should be 0.

panels.title: Host CPU by mode
panels.description: rate(node_cpu_seconds_total) per mode, stacked, as % of all 16 CPUs.

custom.axisLabel: CPU busy (% of 16 logical CPUs, linear)

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: node_load1/5/15. Black dashed line = number of CPUs.

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: used = MemTotal - MemAvailable.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: rate of node_disk_read/written_bytes_total.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: rate of node_network bytes, without lo and docker interfaces.

panels.title: Root disk used
panels.description: Used % of /.

panels.title: RAM used
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable / MemTotal.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: node:cpu_busy:percent from rules.yml. HostCPUHigh fires above 40%.

panels.title: Throughput vs CPU
panels.description: Left: images/s. Right: host CPU % and the app process's CPU % (process_cpu_seconds_total).

panels.title: App memory vs host memory
panels.description: caption_app_memory_rss_bytes vs host used memory.

panels.title: p95 latency vs CPU
panels.description: Left: p95 inference time. Right: host CPU %.
